messages:
Evan Holt: quick sync - need a minimal client contract for 'degraded' responses so telemetry, SDKs, and console show the same thing. short proposals?
Priya Desai: definition: degraded = successful response routed to a lower-fidelity path (model quantization, fallback region, or tenant quota mitigation). treat as orthogonal to errors.
Marco Ruiz: Implementation signals: (1) header for non-JSON clients `X-Redwood-Status: degraded` plus compact KV `X-Redwood-Route: variant=quantized8;reason=QUANTIZED`, (2) top-level meta in JSON bodies `meta.status=degraded` and `meta.reason=QUANTIZED`.
June Park: console needs: aggregate % degraded, samples, and per-tenant attribution when reason=TENANT_QUOTA (include `quota_remaining`). show amber badge for degraded.
Priya Desai: streaming: send an initial control object `:meta` with the same enums. avoid free text. maintain central enum list: MODEL_VARIANT, QUANTIZED, REGION_FALLBACK, TENANT_QUOTA, BURST.
Marco Ruiz: telemetry keys: `request.outcome=degraded`, `request.degrade_reason`, `request.route_variant`. retention: 7d traces, 90d aggregates.
Evan Holt: tests: add e2e that forces TENANT_QUOTA degrade and asserts header + meta + telemetry event.
June Park: UX: optional short hint mapping enum->friendly string in SDKs/console (not in raw responses).
CI Bot: build 3270012355 passed for feature/degrade-contract (sha: cf12ab) :white_check_mark:
Evan Holt: I'll draft the RFC and enum file. Priya/Marco/June will own SDK/server/console tasks. thanks.
